data.narrative:
Resilience, a Series D-stage biotech and health company that has raised approximately $600M to date, is valued here against a peer set of 4 private companies in the same sector and stage cohort, supplemented by reference to 3 public biotech comparables.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable approach. The median valuation across Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Abridge ($5.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B) yields $4.5B. This range spans $3.1B to $10.3B, reflecting material heterogeneity in the peer set—likely driven by differences in clinical stage, funding velocity, and founder pedigree. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 5.5x across RXRX, TEM, and ONT.L) cannot be applied, as Resilience's revenue is not on file; this is typical for early-stage private biotech.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.9B (low) to $5.2B (high), centered on $4.5B. The peer-median method provides the sole quantitative signal; reliance on a single method and a modest peer sample of four companies introduces material uncertainty. Key variables not resolved by available data include Resilience's clinical-stage distribution, capital efficiency relative to peers, and time-to-inflection. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending proprietary due diligence on pipeline and burn profile.
